instruction: Inspect fixture/evidence.json and write triage.json. The output must contain exactly schema_version and cases. schema_version must be 1. cases must be an object keyed by every exact case id c01 through c08. Each case value must contain exactly class, evidence_refs, and next_probe. class must be one of HARNESS_FAILURE, PROVIDER_FAILURE, ENVIRONMENT_FAILURE, AUTHORITY_REQUIRED, ACTOR_FAILURE, VALIDATOR_FAILURE, RECONCILIATION_FAILURE, INCONCLUSIVE. evidence_refs must be a non-empty sorted array of RFC 6901 JSON pointers into fixture/evidence.json, written as fixture/evidence.json#<pointer>. next_probe must be one of FIX_HARNESS_AND_RETRY, ADJUST_RESOURCE_AND_RETRY, REQUEST_NARROW_AUTHORITY, DEFER_OR_RETRY_PROVIDER, PRESERVE_AND_TRY_DISTINCT_ACTOR, REPAIR_VALIDATOR_NEW_TASK_VERSION, RECONCILE_STALE_STATE, COLLECT_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE. Classify the boundary supported by the observable evidence only. Do not treat workflow/job status alone as the verdict. Do not turn provider/engine failures, validator defects, environment/resource exhaustion, or missing authority into actor failure. Preserve INCONCLUSIVE when evidence does not localize causality. Do not modify fixture files.
